metadata.name: Neon Galleria
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A two-storey 1980s shopping mall at night. Halvorsen's and Delmar & Co. anchor the ends (the team bases and flags); between them the concourse runs under galleries and skylights, with escalator stairs, bridges and the fountain court in the middle. Every shop front is glass you can shoot out: records, pets, books, candy, toys, shoes, jewellers, sporting goods with the guns, an arcade full of glowing cabinets, video rental, a multiplex over the neon food court. Every shop has a shutter button that locks its doors for 25 s, so in Zombies you can barricade in. Service corridors run to the loading docks, a two-deck garage with parked cars sits across the road, and the roof is one deck of HVAC units round the skylight well. King of the Hill: the fountain, the food court and the roof.

do.text: Welcome to the Neon Galleria. Open till late.
The Galleria is now closed. Shop buttons pull the shutters down.
